explanation: The nullities are inconsistent. An increase of 5−3=2 at the fourth power requires two Jordan blocks of size at least 4 for eigenvalue π. Those blocks alone would contribute at least 6 to the third-power nullity, contradicting its stated value 3 (and require multiplicity at least 8 rather than 6). The intended subtraction gives 2, option b, but no matrix satisfies the premises.
